mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >50% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% and no rate increase in the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >50% of periods following UNRATE readings below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >50% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 with consecutive monthly drops signals weakening economic output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns during early recession phases.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >50% of periods classified as early recession (INDPRO declining for 2 consecutive months and below 100).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) level indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >50% of periods when GDPC1 shows quarterly growth (current level > previous quarter level).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% annually signals persistent price pressures that trigger near-term Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >50% of periods following CPIAUCSL annual inflation above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate accelerating labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >50% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 with consecutive monthly increases signals economic recovery momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns during post-recession phases.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >50% of periods classified as post-recession recovery (INDPRO rising for 2 consecutive months).
